jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide dates binding on participating NSW employers; applications open 9:00am AEST on Wed 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027, but the guidelines list two staggered closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027) that vary by employer, so a single close date cannot be confirmed.

The firm's own careers page confirms applications are currently closed and will next open in June 2027 for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship intake, but no exact open or close date is published yet (the dates currently shown on the page relate to the completed 2026 cycle).
